| 702-fable | RL at the eval level only: sample 32 per target at 8 thoughts, fine-tune at 8 and never at 0 | claude-fable-5-1 | rl, sampling, thoughts | 0.5 | 5400/300/1800 | 45 | 548 | 329 | 956 | keep | 0.9135 | 0.0844 | 301 778 957 | 2814 | Keep: 548 (535, 562, 546) against 701's 531 (510, 529, 553), up on two seeds (701's mean read from its pod logs; its results were not yet in results/ when this was recorded). The mechanism prediction held, and more: at 0 thoughts this model solves 329 (347, 319, 321) against 701's 479 (466, 476, 496), so the 8-vs-0 gap is 219 theorems here against 52 for 701; per-sample eval accuracy at 0 thoughts is 7-9% against 701's 20-23%, while at 8 thoughts both are 30-31%. I was wrong about 701: its gap did not close to within noise, so the mixed-count fine-tune weakens the thoughts rather than erasing them. Sampling every target 32 times at 8 thoughts found about as many RL targets as 701's 8 at each of 0/2/4/8 (956 against 942 after three rounds) in the same three rounds (469-549 s each, 1,460-1,548 s charged). Same-seed pretrained models vary more than expected: seed 0 started at 4.5% sample accuracy at 8 thoughts against 701's 9.6%, and still ended at 535 against 510. |
| 703-fable | Chained thought groups: level n is ceil(n/4) sequential passes of up to 4 thoughts, so 8 thoughts is two passes deep | claude-fable-5-1 | architecture, thoughts | 0.35 | 5400/300/1800 | 116 | 448 | 253 | 751 | discard | 0.8995 | 0.0800 | 415 734 | 2712 | Discard: 448 (425, 427, 493) against 702's 548, with two RL rounds instead of three. The pretraining was not the cost: 1,286-1,335 steps against 702's 1,530-1,651, yet round-1 sample accuracy at 8 thoughts was 8.3/1.9/14.1% against 702's 4.5% mean, and pretraining val loss ordered 8 < 2 < 0 on two seeds (0.0757/0.0760/0.0781 and 0.0778/0.0789/0.0822), which 701 and 702 never showed. The fine-tune was: at 8 thoughts every line is two passes, so the 600-step fine-tune took about 480 s against 702's 195-250 s, each round ran 660-730 s, and the third round no longer fit (751 RL targets after two rounds against 702's 778 after two and 956 after three). Thoughts still matter after RL: 253 at 0 thoughts, a gap of 195 (702: 219); per-sample eval accuracy 20-25% at 8 against 6-7% at 0 (702: 30-31% and 7-9%). Whether two passes beat one is unresolved: the run never sampled at 2 or 4, and the eval only sees 8 and 0. A follow-up should keep three rounds (FT_STEPS 300, or fine-tune at a one-pass level) and sample once at 2, 4 and 8. |
| 704-fable | Pause-slot thoughts: a thought's input is a learned slot vector, not the trigger's output, so a training step is one causal pass | claude-fable-5-1 | thoughts, architecture, systems, simplification | 0.55 | 5400/300/1800 | 122 | 676 | 482 | 1184 | keep | 0.953 | 0.0843 | 568 942 1086 1128 1161 1178 1191 | 3407 | Keep: 676 (682, 680, 667) against 702's 548 (535, 562, 546), up 105-145 on every seed; the first attempt's two surviving seeds scored 640 and 684 (its seed-1 pod had no working CUDA device, pretrained on CPU for 8 steps and timed out, so the whole experiment was re-run under the same registration; the first attempt is archived in artifacts/autoresearch_thoughts/previous_attempts). But the thoughts are not what scored. metric_diag at 0 thoughts is 670 and 656 on seeds 0 and 1, within 12-24 of the 8-thought score, and pretraining val loss is flat in the thought count on every seed (8 against 0 within 0.001). Seed 2's 121 at 0 thoughts is the no-thought path going out of distribution under RL that trains at 8 only (702's 329 came by the same route), not computation in the slots, since the identical recipe left seeds 0 and 1 level. So the spike's finding holds per line too: pause slots go unused, and the fed-back trigger state of 701-703 was what made 8 thoughts beat 0 there. The gain is speed. Single-pass training gave 3,398-3,784 pretraining steps (702: 1,530-1,651) and fine-tunes of 76-118 s instead of 195-254 s, so RL ran 6-7 rounds instead of 3 (RL targets 1,184 against 956) with 1,564-1,729 of 1,800 s charged. Two predictions failed: the pretraining val loss did not fall (0.0843-0.0869 against 702's 0.0817-0.0844 at 2.2x the steps, though held-out greedy accuracy rose to 0.953-0.963 from 0.899-0.920), so per step the pause model learns less than the feedback model; and the thoughts' contribution did not survive without feedback. Round-1 sample accuracy at 8 thoughts varied 5.4-18.9% across seeds (first attempt 2.6-5.2%), so pretrained-model variance stays large. Next: put the feedback back on top of this single-pass trunk at a cost below one pass per line (thought inputs from a lower block's state at the trigger, or one extra pass over the expanded sequence), and read whether 8 beats 0 in the pretraining val loss, the cheap place to see it. |
